scope: Partial native IOGPU/Metal A540 driver with bounded MSL/AIR JIT,2D/2DArray/Cube/CubeArray color resources, native render/compute, graphics direct fetch/queries and observed float32 AIR texture read/write/query/sample/gradient signatures. Constexpr samplers, argument buffers, wider formats/language/types, nonzero AIR offsets/min-LOD, persistent task VA, generic queues/events, CAMetalLayer/display and full power/fault/runtime behavior remain incomplete. No target execution; complete families remain disabled.

asynchronous_completion.completion_means: end token after actual hardware timestamp, cache and IOSurface retirement
asynchronous_completion.read_only_client_stamp_mapping: native deviceUserClientStart 0xfffffff005f2474c, createMappingInTask options 0x4001001 includes kIOMapReadOnly
asynchronous_completion.native_idle_epoch_rebase: requires no jobs, no fences/callbacks, only the current Family call, and idle validated queues; clears stale queue/start events under native fence lock

private_submission_address_spaces.entry: idle/protected-mode off/APRIV/wait ME/SMMU table update/invalidate draw state/APRIV off/protected-mode on
private_submission_address_spaces.exit: ordered return to kernel TTBR0 before global hardware timestamp
retirement: hardware timestamp or proven ME/PFP halt and AXI drain
release page tables and original DMA backing; recycle ASID
private_submission_address_spaces.cpu_health_accepts: retained kernel root or registered live job root only
private_submission_address_spaces.startup_and_cp_recovery_self_test: GPU writes pattern through private root; return-to-kernel hardware timestamp, CPU acquire/readback and private ASID retirement required before native readiness

shader_control_flow.address_proof: NIR bounds checks of actual SSBO byte ranges; pointer/address PHIs remain unsupported

compute_workgroups.buffer_index_proof: NIR per-component byte-range guards; legacy programs retain global X footprint
compute_workgroups.nonuniform_implementation: Cartesian full/tail regions, at most eight CP_EXEC_CS launches with actual local sizes inside one original native submission and completion fence

bounded_buffer_access.address_model: 64-bit relative GEP arithmetic represented as two uint32 words; aligned word access only; physical base remains an opaque binding
bounded_buffer_access.load_policy: per-component zero outside the actual binding byte range
bounded_buffer_access.descriptor_size_source: A5xx SSBO resinfo returns byte count as low/high 16 bits
msl_constants: readonly struct fields with Metal float3 padding
references: Pinned Mesa src/freedreno/ir3/ir3_compiler_nir.c emit_intrinsic_ssbo_size and src/compiler/nir/ API
Pinned Mesa src/gallium/drivers/freedreno/freedreno_screen.c PIPE_SHADER_CAP_MAX_SHADER_BUFFERS and a5xx/fd5_emit.c emit_ssbos; ir3/ir3_image.c ir3_ssbo_to_ibo

msl_storage: threadgroup scalar/vector/atomic pointer or reference arguments [[threadgroup(0..7)]]
threadgroup_memory.air_storage: Uninitialized addrspace(3) globals and air.buffer addrspace(3) arguments; 32-bit scalar/vector/relaxed integer atomic accesses
threadgroup_memory.backend: Mesa IR3 LDL/STL, FENCE and BAR; fd5_compute.c fixed HLSQ_CS_CNTL_1=1
threadgroup_memory.address_bounds: Invalid or huge relative offsets are clamped to the 32 KiB capacity before NIR adds a variable base; final per-component NIR bounds cover the allocated shared region and intrinsic-base overflow.
threadgroup_memory.dynamic_layout: Static objects precede a 16-byte-aligned raw shared pool; native admission packs positive aligned lengths within the combined 32768-byte capacity. The first 16 IR3 constant words hold relative byte offsets and lengths.
threadgroup_memory.dynamic_bounds: Per-argument 64-bit offset/alignment/component checks precede each shared access; invalid loads/atomics return zero and invalid stores/atomics do not execute. Final shared NIR guards also enforce the 32768-byte allocation.
threadgroup_memory.compiler_integration: Defer GL shared-variable layout for the generated dynamic pool; Interface.h assigns its base, trims the reservation and lowers explicit shared IO. Reserve 16 scalar user constants for dynamic shared memory, or 48 when compute textures are active, before driver params/immediates. Pad query-only constant uploads to the complete reserved prefix.

memory: compute static and dynamic threadgroup memory
integer_atomics.load_lowering: atomicOr(0), conservatively treated as a write
integer_atomics.signed_minmax_lowering: CAS retry over the raw uint view
integer_atomics.weak_cas: strong CAS is used; no spurious failure
integer_atomics.cas_expected: matching thread-local int32 scalar; updated on comparison failure
air_forms: LLVM int32 atomicrmw/cmpxchg and relaxed atomic load/store
integer_atomics.bounds: Per-word NIR guard branches around the atomic; out-of-range/unaligned operations execute no atomic and return zero
references: Pinned Mesa ir3/ir3_a4xx.c emit_atomic/emit_intrinsic_atomic_ssbo and ir3_compiler_nir.c emit_intrinsic_atomic_shared

texture_mipmaps.linear_layout: RGBA8 fdl5, pitchalign=8 (256 bytes), fdl_pitch minifies aligned base pitch with a minimum of one before alignment; last level has 32-row padding; complete layer is page aligned
texture_mipmaps.single_level_compatibility: existing 64-byte row alignment and exact image span; IOSurface remains single-level
compiler_sample_lod: AIR sample mode with float32 level or bias
texture_mipmaps.generation: mipmap_rgba8 AOT compute kernel, per-level nonoverlapping source texture0 and destination image7; sampler0 linear filtering in linear RGB; sRGB encoded by bounded image stores; serial native fences; no CPU generation
texture_mipmaps.native_range: View-relative full mip access span checked against the backing resource and alias spans; owner allocation retains the canonical padded last level and page-aligned layer.
texture_mipmaps.sampler_lod: unsigned 8.8 min/max, mip none/nearest/linear; fd5 none clamps to 0.125
references: Metal SDK MTLBlitCommandEncoder whole-mip copy and generateMipmaps contracts
Metal SDK MTLRenderCommandEncoder sampler LOD clamps

compute_textures.mip_level: dynamic uint32; complete or truncated linear fdl5 color chain
compute_textures.native_ownership: Resolve current-device resource IDs; validate full mip-chain ranges and IOSurface metadata; retain resources and GPU-write accounting until actual completion. Geometry constants are computed by native admission.
compute_textures.usage: Explicit ShaderRead/ShaderWrite required according to actual load/store masks; query-only needs neither; Unknown remains unspecified.
compute_textures.a540_backend: Real guarded IR3 LDGB/STGB over coherent SSBOs, CS state block 15, independent physical bindings 8..15; ordinary compute buffers use 0..7.

constants.driver_immediates: after the reserved prefix; query-only images also pad constlen to the complete prefix

compute_textures.bounds: Check mip/coordinates before address arithmetic and final NIR SSBO byte size; invalid loads return zero, invalid writes do not execute.
compute_textures.conversion: RGBA/BGRA channel conversion, UNorm8 unpack/pack; stores clamp 0..1 and replace NaN with zero.
compute_textures.barrier: mem_texture uses memoryBarrierBuffer plus workgroup execution barrier; A5xx loads/stores are cache coherent.
references: Pinned Mesa a5xx/fd5_image.c image state block and freedreno_screen.c compute SSBO capacity
Pinned Mesa ir3/ir3_compiler_nir.c SSBO loads/stores and A5xx cache coherence

compiler: MSL compute sample defaults to level 0
AIR nine-parameter normalized sample, explicit float32 level or zero implicit bias
GL combined pair recovered from generated name after opaque-uniform lowering, then split to independent NIR indices shared by AOT/JIT
compute_texture_sampling.hardware: A540 CS texture state block5; logical samplers0..7 plus explicit-LOD shadow8..15; image SSBO state15; CS TEX_COUNT/HLSQ update.
compute_texture_sampling.alias_policy: Physical sampling ranges cannot overlap writable image/buffer ranges in the same dispatch; read-only pairings may share backing
compute_texture_sampling.sampler_profile: Sampler 28-byte semantic state: six address modes with stated mixed-border restriction, AF1..16, predefined border colors, normalized or restricted pixel coords; implicit/bias/gradient clamps, explicit level ignores clamps.

sampler_state.mirror_clamp: Production GLSL abs/gradient reflection with native-owned flags for POT/NPOT. Fragment implicit/bias sampling preserves derivatives of the original coordinates before mirror reflection.
sampler_state.anisotropy_encoding: Mesa fd5 floor-power-of-two cap; ANISO filter only when linear filtering is selected
sampler_state.pixel_coordinates_restrictions: edge modes, no mip filter, anisotropy one
sampler_state.border_table: Three immutable A5xx 128-byte entries in private read-only IB, 512-byte aligned
sampler_state.unsupported: Mixed S/T ClampToZero and nontransparent ClampToBorderColor in one sampler; depth comparison and arbitrary custom colors
sampler_state.explicit_lod: Dedicated unclamped hardware sampler slots: CS logical+8, FS 1, shared texture index; implicit/bias/gradient retain clamps
sampler_state.gradient: MSL gradient2d for compute/vertex/fragment AOT/JIT, real IR3 derivative sampling; AIR gradient ABI not inferred
sampler_state.constants: Compute sampler flags at words 48..55 in reserved 64-word prefix; Fragment flags at word 0 in reserved 16-word prefix; image-only 48 and dynamic-shared-only 16 remain
sampler_state.wire: shader/JIT 25/22; Texture44, Sampler28, Dispatch792, Draw2168, description1744/image20296
references: Apple MSL specification texture LOD semantics
sampler_state.derivative_lowering: Standalone GL NIR options set scalarize_ddx=true, matching pinned IR3 compiler requirements before vector ddx/ddy are created.

srgb_color_formats.storage: existing four-byte linear fdl5 layout and task-authorized IOSurface imports
srgb_color_formats.sampling: A5xx TEX_CONST_0_SRGB, RGB decoding before filtering
srgb_color_formats.render: RB_MRT_BUF_INFO_COLOR_SRGB and SP_FS_MRT_REG_COLOR_SRGB; fixed-function linear blending
srgb_color_formats.image_read_write: shared MSL/AIR AOT/JIT GLSL helpers decode/encode RGB around bounded SSBO loads/stores; alpha remains linear
srgb_color_formats.mipmap: native per-level dispatch, source plane sampler0/texture0, destination image7; nonoverlapping physical subranges; hardware bilinear linear-space filtering; sRGB encode before guarded stores
srgb_color_formats.cpu_blit: raw encoded bytes; user-mode clear encodes linear RGB once

texture_views.type: 2D and color 2DArray, nonempty parent-relative mip/slice ranges; nested views flatten offsets and retain the original layer stride and parent
texture_views.storage: no new GPU resource/allocation; textureSize checks addressable pitch*height mip span, allocation still uses the complete padded fdl5 layout
texture_views.compiler: unchanged MSL/AIR AOT/JIT geometry and mip functions operate relative to the rebased view
texture_views.native: original task/resource/session, geometry, CPU/GPU synchronization and physical alias checks are preserved; compatible IOSurface color views retain single-level geometry
texture_views.render_blit_clear: view-selected plane offsets, format and dimensions; copies compare actual backing byte ranges rather than relative mip indices
texture_views.sampling: A5xx 2D descriptors use the rebased pointer/pitch, visible mip and layer counts, and the original layer stride. RGBA/BGRA/sRGB/swizzle state remains independent of the layer geometry.
references: Pinned Mesa fdl5_layout: final 32-row allocation padding is required by GMEM blits; this backend exposes only direct 2D sampling/rendering and bounded linear buffer copies

texture_swizzle.encoding: Zero is identity; otherwise four semantic 3-bit channel selectors plus one. All-zero swizzle has encoding1. Invalid selectors/high bits are rejected.
texture_swizzle.composition: view selectors index the effective parent pattern; constants are propagated; a view without an explicit swizzle inherits the parent pattern.
texture_swizzle.native_sampling: A5xx SWIZ_X/Y/Z/W composed with storage-format RGBA/BGRA order; sRGB conversion precedes read swizzle.
texture_swizzle.compute_reads: Shared MSL/AIR AOT/JIT read helper decodes sRGB, fixes BGRA order, then applies native-owned swizzle bits in image geometry word.w[16..27].
texture_swizzle.mip_count: Image geometry word.w[8..15] is masked independently from swizzle; get_num_mip_levels and coordinate/mip bounds keep the visible view count.
texture_swizzle.writes: Compute stores, render attachments, clears and byte copies ignore read swizzle. Internal blit mip generation clears swizzle in source/destination descriptors so successive levels filter stored color without accumulating channel permutations.
texture_swizzle.oob: Existing bounded RGBA/BGRA reads return all-zero for invalid coordinates/mip before swizzle; stores remain suppressed.
texture_swizzle.depth_stencil: Identity only within the existing render-only profile.
primary_references: Pinned Mesa fd5_format.c fd5_tex_swiz and a5xx.xml a5xx_tex_swiz

nonuniform_compute.implementation: Cartesian full/tail regions, at most eight CP_EXEC_CS launches with actual local sizes inside one original native submission and completion fence
nonuniform_compute.driver_constants: Actual physical region local/groups, zero hardware base group; native read-only word64..79 contains global thread/group bases, original grid/group counts and requested local XYZ in words67/71/75.
nonuniform_compute.resource_state: Code, textures/samplers/SSBO descriptors are uploaded once; constants and NDRANGE are updated per region; real threads only, group-local shared allocation and barriers preserved.
nonuniform_compute.limits: Original active grid <=16777216 invocations, requested local product <=1024, group XYZ<=65535 and requested Z<=64; actual groups=ceil(grid/local). Fixed-size trusted kernels reject partial groups.
references: Pinned Mesa fd5_compute.c and A5xx NDRANGE/CP_EXEC_CS state

texture_arrays.layout: Layer-major fdl5 mip chains. Each array layer stride is page-aligned; views retain the owner stride and native bounds cover the actual last-layer/mip access span.
texture_arrays.views: Nested nonempty mip and slice ranges; 2D<->2DArray views, one slice for 2D; direct parent and backing retained.
texture_arrays.cpu_blit: Per-slice CPU reads/writes and buffer/texture copies; all source/destination intervals checked before range copies. Per-slice mip generation uses the existing hardware sampler/guarded store and native completion fences.
texture_arrays.render: One selected color slice/mip per attachment, same existing sysmem render backend; no vertex-selected layered rendering.
texture_arrays.compiler: MSL AOT and runtime JIT texture2d_array<float, read/write/read_write/sample>; read/write/query plus implicit/level/bias/gradient2d sampling in the same previously supported stages. AIR array intrinsics remain rejected until an actual target ABI signature is verified.
texture_arrays.native: Per-binding array type in flags bits8..15; shader/resource dimensionality must match. Compute word80..95 stores eight layer-count/byte-stride pairs before driver/immediates. FS uses native DEPTH and ARRAY_PITCH with its existing 16-word sampler prefix.
texture_arrays.image_bounds: Array slice and coordinate/mip bounds checked before address multiplication. Invalid bounded reads return zero and writes are suppressed. Swizzle and sRGB preserve existing semantics.
texture_arrays.iosurface: Creation/import stays single 2D layer; compatible 2DArray-one-layer views may share the existing authorized backing; multi-layer imported descriptors are rejected.
references: Mesa 24.3.4 pinned fd5_texture.c/fdl5_layout and IR3 array sampler lowering

msl_sampling: implicit level zero with ordinary sampler clamps
explicit float level ignoring sampler clamps
air_sampling: implicit level zero with zero bias
explicit float level using existing verified 2D intrinsic signature
vertex_texture_sampling.native_state: SB4_VS_TEX block0 and TPL1_VS_TEX_COUNT, independent from fragment block4/count. Existing texture layout, view layer stride/count, sRGB/swizzle, border color and sampler shadow state are reused.
vertex_texture_sampling.constants: Vertex and fragment sampler helpers each reserve16 words in their own stage. Mirror flags are at stage word0; driver/immediates follow the prefix. Vertex-only GLSL uniform names prevent link-time aliasing with fragment controls.
vertex_texture_sampling.resource_lifetime: Per-draw descriptor and sampler snapshots retain vertex texture/view/sampler and backing until the original native real-completion fence.
vertex_texture_sampling.alias_policy: Vertex/fragment read-only textures may alias each other or read-only buffers. Attachments and fragment buffer writes are checked against both texture stages using existing strided pinned physical-page ranges.
references: Pinned Mesa24.3.4 fd5_emit.c/IR3 and SB4_VS_TEX in adreno_pm4.xml

graphics_texture_bindings.native_state: VS block0 and FS block4 upload each active texture/sampler at its logical slot; texture count is highest active texture slot plus one. Both counts reset every draw.
graphics_texture_bindings.resource_lifetime: Separate masks admit and retain only active texture and sampler slots to real completion; unreferenced wire slots must be empty. Original task authorization, resource quota and strided physical overlap checks remain.

cube_textures.layout: Each face contains an fdl5 mip chain with page-aligned original face stride. Array length counts cubes; physical slice count is six times cube count.
cube_textures.views: Full cube groups, nested mip/cube subranges, single-face2D and face-range2DArray views retain parent/backing/original stride. Cube view slice count is six, or a multiple of six for CubeArray; first slice is preserved independently.
cube_textures.cpu_blit_render_mipmap: Existing slice operations use physical face count; selected face render/clear and per-face mip generation use2D planes.
cube_textures.native_type: Texture.cube Boolean; layers counts cubes for CubeArray and zero denotes one Cube. Flags16..23 mark cube texture slots; existing8..15 marks array types.
cube_textures.native_sampler: cubeSamplerMask identifies actual sampler bindings, enforces normalized coordinates and enables A5xx seamless filtering only for cube samplers. Cube direction coordinates do not use2D mirror abs lowering.
cube_textures.native_descriptor: A5xx TYPE2, original face ARRAY_PITCH, DEPTH number of cubes. Sampler and texture bindings remain independent.

cube_images.index_order: 2D coordinate, face, optional cube element, optional mip level. Writes prepend float4 color.
cube_images.native_constants: Existing image words16..47 describe dimensions/pitch/format/mips/swizzle; words80..95 contain actual physical face count and original face byte stride.
cube_images.type_metadata: Shape-specific native-owned uniform names derive cube/array image masks without requiring a sampler. cubeSamplerMask reflects sampled cube textures only.
cube_images.face_address: (cube*6+face)*originalFaceStride + existing2D mip/row offset; validate face<6 and cube<faceCount/6 before multiplication.
cube_images.color_helpers: Reuse production planar sRGB/BGRA/swizzle helpers in shape-specific namespaces; stores ignore view swizzle.

shader_code_fetch.compute: Above32 units, disable BUFFER and both cached-length registers and skip CP shader preload; retain SP object address for memory fetch.
shader_code_fetch.graphics: When VS+FS exceed64 units, follow fd5_program.c FS-first cache partition; one or both stages fetch from memory.
shader_code_fetch.lifetime: All code bytes remain in the read-only private job IB and address space through real completion or quarantine.

graphics_texture_fetch.descriptor_count: highest active sampled or fetch-alias descriptor + 1; zero for query-only programs
graphics_texture_fetch.samplers: Only sample operations require sampler state. Integer fetches use ISAML without a public sampler.
graphics_texture_fetch.cube_alias: 2D array of physical faces, with original face stride, mip range, format and swizzle; validate face and cube separately before flattening.
graphics_texture_fetch.native_constants: 48-word prefix: sampler controls in words0..15, native width/height/logical array or cube count/format+mips+swizzle in words16..47.
graphics_texture_fetch.query_only: Resource validated and retained through native fence completion; no texture descriptor or pixel feedback hazard. Actual sample/fetch accesses retain attachment and write-alias rejection.
graphics_texture_fetch.oob_read: zero for invalid coordinates, face, element or mip

read_forms: legacy without sampler or planar offset
current with get_read_sampler and zero planar offset
air_texture_operations.coordinates: 32-bit integer coord/face/element/mip; float32 sample directions and gradients
air_texture_operations.texel: float4, direct or {float4,i8} with unavailable residency byte
air_texture_operations.binding_checks: Intrinsic shape and access immediate must match native semantic texture metadata; current reads require a distinct builtin read-sampler value, never a public Metal sampler.
air_texture_operations.underlying_read_backend: Compute guarded image SSBOs; graphics integer-fetch descriptor aliases8..15; native IOGPU resources and fence lifetime unchanged.
air_texture_operations.primary_reference_toolchain: Public modern Apple metal32023.883/32023.921 outputs; acceptance of observed forms is not an iOS18 ABI or runtime guarantee. Existing older2D AIR forms retained.
air_texture_operations.texture_result_ssa: Materialize float4 texels at the original AIR read/sample call, including aggregate results; later extraction or branches do not reissue a resource read across writes or move implicit derivatives.
air_texture_operations.runtime_32bit_conversions: Typed air.convert between float32 and signed/unsigned int32 scalars or vectors1..4, validated name/type agreement; no guessed rounding/saturation modifiers.
